sentences.text: Caspiodontornis is a genus of prehistoric pseudotooth birds.
The genus Caspiodontornis was described by Aslanova and Burchak-Abramovich in 1982.
The only known species is Caspiodontornis kobystanicus.
The genus is placed in the order Odontopterygiformes due to uncertainty regarding its closest relatives.
Caspiodontornis belongs to the family Pelagornithidae.
Caspiodontornis lived during the Late Oligocene epoch.
It lived between 27.3 and 23.04 million years ago during the Chattian stage.
